Minor, non-blocking: test_console.py:299 uses skipif(sys.platform == "win32", reason="legacy windows console") even though the test passes legacy_windows=False (line 301-302). The skip is unnecessary and its reason is inaccurate, since with legacy_windows=False rich/console.py:1973-1989 (_render_buffer) takes the text path on every platform. The adjacent test_show_cursor has no skip, and the reference guards with `if console.legacy_windows: return` instead.
